hints.title: Subtree Aggregates
hints.text: For every node, the average requires the sum of all node values and the total node count in its subtree.

hints.title: Postorder Bottom-Up Aggregation
hints.text: A bottom-up traversal can return (subtree_sum, subtree_count) from children to compute parent metrics directly.

hints.title: Floor Division Condition
hints.text: Check if node value equals total_sum // total_count, and increment the match count when true.

hints.title: Postorder Subtree Metric Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def averageOfSubtree(self, root) -> int:
        ans = 0
        def dfs(node):
            nonlocal ans
            if not node:
                return 0, 0
            l_sum, l_cnt = dfs(node.left)
            r_sum, r_cnt = dfs(node.right)
            s = l_sum + r_sum + node.val
            c = l_cnt + r_cnt + 1
            if s // c == node.val:
                ans += 1
            return s, c
        dfs(root)
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Single postorder traversal visits each node once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing sum and count separately for each node takes O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Recursion stack proportional to tree height.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate returns both sum and count from subtrees in a single bottom-up pass.
